content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a set of free and open-source tools that enable digital creators to build, deploy, and own their own digital commerce stacks. It's not a workaround or a hack – it's a base-layer infrastructure solution that gives you full control over your business. By using a combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you can create a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This means you're no longer at the mercy of Stripe, PayPal, or any other payment gatekeeper.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the use of Cloudflare Workers, which processes 100,000 requests per day on the free tier. This means you can handle a large volume of traffic without incurring any additional costs. Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage on the free tier, allowing you to store all your order and customer data in a scalable and secure way. NOWPayments handles the automatic crypto payment processing, giving you access to over 300 cryptocurrencies and a 0.5% fee. By combining these tools, you get a seamless and secure payment processing experience that's fully under your control.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built for digital creators who want to sell digital products without relying on Western payment gatekeepers. If you're an author selling ebooks, a course creator, a graphic designer, or any other type of digital product seller, this solution is for you. By using sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can break free from the arbitrary country or platform restrictions that have held you back and scale your business without worrying about platform suspensions.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your business and your customer data.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of sovereign commerce infrastructure include GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. Each component plays a critical role in creating a seamless and secure payment processing experience. By combining these tools, you get a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and download the 6 blueprints plus 7 templates. Create a GitHub Pages site and configure it for hosting. Set up a Cloudflare Workers account and configure it for backend logic. Set up a Supabase account and configure it for order storage. Set up a NOWPayments account and configure it for automatic crypto payment processing. Deploy your infrastructure and test it thoroughly. Frequently Asked Questions
What is the cost of using sovereign commerce infrastructure?

The cost of using sovereign commerce infrastructure is zero for the infrastructure itself, as it's built using free and open-source tools. However, you may incur costs for hosting, storage, and other services.
How does sovereign commerce infrastructure handle payment processing?
Sovereign commerce infrastructure uses NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing, giving you access to over 300 cryptocurrencies and a 0.5% fee.
Can I use sovereign commerce infrastructure with my existing website?
Yes, you can use sovereign commerce infrastructure with your existing website. However, you may need to modify your website's code to integrate with the sovereign commerce infrastructure components.
How does sovereign commerce infrastructure handle customer data?
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your customer data, which is stored in Supabase. You can access and manage your customer data as needed.
Is sovereign commerce infrastructure secure?
Yes, sovereign commerce infrastructure is secure. It uses Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing, both of which are secure and reliable services.
